messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need a final call on how SDKs expose streamed cursor resumption across Python/TS/Go. Do we: (A) keep resume token in transport only and expose a single high-level iterator, or (B) surface explicit resume tokens/APIs in each client?

Jake: leaning toward (A) for DX. high-level iterator with automatic resume + safe retries feels nicest for app devs. hide complexity. :+1:

Olivia: +1 for ergonomics, but Go idioms prefer explicit control. if we auto-resume we need a way to opt-out and surface errors deterministically. also memory/conn implications.

Sam: operational concern — automatic resume can mask partial writes / exactly-once semantics. are requests idempotent? if not, auto-resume could duplicate side-effects. we need clear guidance and an opt-in idempotency token mechanism.

Maria: good point. proposal: default high-level iterator in Python/TS that does transparent resume when the server returns a resumable marker, but require explicit Resume() API in Go, and add an opt-in idempotency param to the request object. we document risk.

Jake: sketch for Python surface:
```python
for item in client.stream_items(request, idempotency_key="abc"):
    handle(item)
# client handles reconnect + resume, raises StreamError if non-resumable failure
```
Jake: TS surface similar using async iterator.

Olivia: For Go suggestion:
```go
iter := client.StreamItems(ctx, req)
for iter.Next() {
    item := iter.Value()
    process(item)
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
    if err.(ResumeableError) {
        token := err.ResumeToken()
        // app can decide to Resume(token) or inspect
    }
}
```
Olivia: That keeps control and aligns with existing Go patterns.

Sam: also we should add a transport-level header like `X-Resume-Token` so Private/Dedicated infra can log/route resumptions. engbot: noted: add telemetry event for resume_attempt with fields: sdk_lang, client_version, resume_token_hash.

Maria: decision checklist: 1) Default UX: Python/TS auto-resume; Go explicit resume. 2) Add idempotency_key on requests. 3) Transport header `X-Resume-Token` + telemetry. 4) Fail-fast mode for apps that want no-resume. 5) Docs + migration guide. anyone object?

Jake: no objections. also add an escape hatch environment variable to disable auto-resume for troubleshooting.

Olivia: fine with that. we should add an RFC follow-up for the exact error types and how to represent ResumeableError in gRPC vs HTTP.

Sam: I'll create test scenarios for duplicates and partial-apply, and run them against Dedicated. will also validate telemetry shape.

engbot: deploybot: created issue INF-2345 with checklist: "sdk resume tokens: surfaces + infra headers + telemetry" assigned to @Maria, priority P2. :white_check_mark:

Maria: thanks — I'll draft the RFC follow-up and the cross-lang example PRs. ping me if you want to bikeshed names (ResumeToken vs ContinuationID).
